instead of deferring the VMWRITE until vmx_set_cr3().  If the VMWRITE
is deferred
column2: then KVM can consume a stale vmcs02.GUEST_CR3 when it

column1: refreshes vmcs12->guest_cr3 during nested_vmx_vmexit() if the emulated
VM-Exit occurs without actually entering L2
is squashed because nested VM-Enter (from L1) is putting L2 into HLT.

column2: the above scenario can occur regardless of whether L1 is

column1: intercepting HLT
column2: e.g. L1 can intercept HLT and then re-enter L2 with

column1: vmcs.GUEST_ACTIVITY_STATE=HALTED.  But practically speaking
likely put a guest into HALTED if and only if it's not intercepting HLT.

column2: VMX could handle CR3 similar to how it handles RSP and RIP

column1: e.g. mark CR3 dirty and conditionally load it at vmx_vcpu_run().  But
